reviews.title: Amazing Budget Air Cooling Option
reviews.comment: This Thermalright Assassin Spirit 120 EVO cooler is amazing for the price points and I have no complaints whatsoever. The performance this cooler puts out under load and at idle is well within the margin of coolers that are higher priced. Before I installed this cooler I was running a Phanteks 240 AIO and getting temps of around the low 30s on idle and mid 40s during gaming sessions. This cooler does run a little bit hotter, with one fan at least, than my AIO however, its not by much. My CPU temps are still well within the normal specs that they should be under idle and under load. Whether its gaming or just daily computer use such as checking emails, internet browsing, or anything else, this air cooler handles it with ease. The build quality for a single stack air cooler like this one is just as good as name brand coolers that are twice, maybe even three times, its price. I believe I picked this cooler up for $26 and it has not disappointed me once. This is an AMAZING value for the $$$ and I would definitely recommend this brand to any new PC builders or seasoned builders. The kit includes its own thermal paste, one 120mm rgb fan, and a set of brackets to clip the fan to the heatsink. I replaced the included fan with a Thermaltake Riing 120 fan I had from a previous build and its kept the temperature nice and cool. All in all, a solid cooler for the price point with the performance to match at a user friendly price.
reviews.author: Austin Walker
